meta.title: Behavioral Mechanics of App-Based Investment Frauds

hypotheses.title: Dark design overrides deliberate judgment
hypotheses.prediction: Fraud players deposit more in total (and decide faster, invest more often, verify less, trust more, feel more urgency).
hypotheses.verdict_reason: predicted direction but not significant (primary p = 0.102 ≥ 0.10; 2 of 6 secondary tests significant in the predicted direction)

hypotheses.title: Countdown timers and "only 3 slots left"
hypotheses.prediction: Fraud players make the first decision faster than honest players.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: predicted direction but not significant (primary p = 0.494 ≥ 0.10; the secondary outcomes are descriptive shares without a test)

hypotheses.title: Sign-up bonus locked until the first deposit
hypotheses.prediction: More fraud players invest in round 1 (the first real deposit).
hypotheses.verdict_reason: predicted direction but not significant (primary p = 1.000 ≥ 0.10; the secondary outcomes are descriptive shares without a test)

hypotheses.title: VIP levels
hypotheses.prediction: More fraud players deposit at least ₹5,000 (VIP 2).
hypotheses.verdict_reason: estimate points the opposite way and is not significant (p = 0.658): no evidence for the predicted effect

hypotheses.title: Fake regulatory credentials
hypotheses.prediction: Fewer fraud players open any T&C, details, badge or About page.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: primary in the predicted direction, p = 0.002 < 0.05

hypotheses.title: Social proof (ticker, testimonials)
hypotheses.prediction: Fraud players make the first decision faster than honest players.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: predicted direction but not significant (primary p = 0.494 ≥ 0.10; the secondary outcomes are descriptive shares without a test)

hypotheses.title: Mentor chat nudging deposits
hypotheses.prediction: Fraud players (who see the chat right before round 4) stake more in round 4.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: predicted direction but not significant (primary p = 0.148 ≥ 0.10; the secondary outcomes are descriptive shares without a test)

hypotheses.title: Withdrawal blocked by a "tax"
hypotheses.prediction: Fraud players pay the tax to unlock their withdrawal.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: no comparison group exists in the design; the rate is descriptive

hypotheses.title: UX map: which features felt persuasive
hypotheses.prediction: Descriptive: rank the seven features by the share of fraud players who felt pushed.

hypotheses.title: An early small win increases later investment
hypotheses.prediction: Players randomized to a +8% round 1 escalate their round-2 stake more than players with a flat round 1.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: estimate points the opposite way and is not significant (p = 0.551): no evidence for the predicted effect

hypotheses.title: People trust faster when stakes are small
hypotheses.prediction: At ₹500 players open the deal details least and invest most.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: estimate points the opposite way and is not significant (p = 0.336): no evidence for the predicted effect

hypotheses.title: Loss aversion drives loss chasing
hypotheses.prediction: A higher loss-aversion group predicts topping up after the crash.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: estimate points the opposite way and is not significant (p = 0.084): no evidence for the predicted effect

hypotheses.title: A friend's referral lowers verification
hypotheses.prediction: More players join the Diamond Pool when the invite comes from a friend.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: estimate points the opposite way and is not significant (p = 0.416): no evidence for the predicted effect

hypotheses.title: A small successful withdrawal builds trust
hypotheses.prediction: Players offered the ₹500 test withdrawal deposit more right after it.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: estimate points the opposite way and is not significant (p = 0.542): no evidence for the predicted effect

hypotheses.title: App profits are treated as house money
hypotheses.prediction: More is put into the Gold Plan when it is funded from the Profit wallet than from Main.
hypotheses.verdict_reason: estimate points the opposite way and is not significant (p = 0.714): no evidence for the predicted effect
